mapper.insert: INSERT INTO accommodations ( host_id, title, description, address, sido_code, gugun_code, latitude, longitude, status, check_in_time, check_out_time, amenities, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{hostId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{address}, #{sidoCode}, #{gugunCode}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{status}, #{checkInTime}, #{checkOutTime}, #{amenities}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT a.*, u.username as host_name FROM accommodations a LEFT JOIN users u ON a.host_id = u.user_id WHERE a.accommodation_id = #{accommodationId}

mapper.select: SELECT a.*, u.username as host_name, sd.sido_name as sido_name, gg.gugun_name as gugun_name FROM accommodations a JOIN accommodations base ON a.sido_code = base.sido_code AND a.gugun_code = base.gugun_code LEFT JOIN users u ON a.host_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sido sd ON a.sido_code = sd.sido_code LEFT JOIN gugun gg ON a.gugun_code = gg.gugun_code WHERE base.accommodation_id = #{accommodationId} AND a.accommodation_id IS NOT NULL AND a.accommodation_id != #{accommodationId} AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT #{limit}
